sql.query: SELECT c.id,COALESCE(MAX(msg.id),0) lastMessageId FROM tbl_chat_conversations c INNER JOIN tbl_chat_participants cp ON cp.conversationId=c.id AND cp.tenantId=c.tenantId AND cp.userId=:userId AND cp.isActive=1 LEFT JOIN tbl_chat_messages msg ON msg.conversationId=c.id AND msg.tenantId=c.tenantId AND msg.isDeleted=0 WHERE c.id=:conversationId AND c.tenantId=:tenantId AND c.conversationType='direct' AND c.isActive=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='TEAM_CHAT' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=c.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles membership INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=membership.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='chat.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE membership.userId=:userId2 AND membership.tenantId=c.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1) GROUP BY c.id
